patch.summary:
Choose Zendesk Suite only if your buying job matches “Enterprise helpdesk and Suite omnichannel — Support Team from $19/agent/mo annual; Suite T” rather than Intercom's shape. Choose Intercom only if your buying job matches “Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin from $0.9” rather than Zendesk Suite's shape. Workflow advantage: Zendesk Suite leans helpdesk-ticketing, omnichannel-support; Intercom leans live-chat-support, customer-messaging. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Positioning: Zendesk Suite is Enterprise helpdesk and Suite omnichannel — Support Team from $19/agent/mo annual; Suite Team $55, Suite Pro $115.; Intercom is Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin from $0.99/outcome. Primary live-chat; BC + CS secondary..
- Company-size focus: Zendesk Suite (mid-market, enterprise) vs Intercom (small-business, mid-market, enterprise).
- Workflow coverage skew: Zendesk Suite-leaning helpdesk-ticketing, omnichannel-support vs Intercom-leaning live-chat-support, customer-messaging, whatsapp-support.
- Researched limits: Zendesk Suite — Suite Pro at $115/agent/mo annual is expensive for SMB teams; Intercom — Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume.

Limitations — Zendesk Suite: Suite Pro at $115/agent/mo annual is expensive for SMB teams; Zendesk Sell (CRM) is a separate product — do not conflate slugs; Intercom: Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume; SMS, WhatsApp and Phone are pay-as-you-go add-on channels, not unlimited included.

Poor-fit cases: Zendesk Suite is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Suite Pro at $115/agent/mo annual is expensive for SMB teams · Intercom is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Seat + Fin outcome pricing stacks — TCO rises with AI resolution volume · Avoid Zendesk Suite if you actually need Intercom's motion (Customer messaging / shared inbox with Fin AI — Essential from $29/seat/mo + Fin)
